slot.brief: Projectile launched from ground with given speed and angle; find a standard quantity such as time of flight or horizontal range using two suvat equations.

stem: A projectile is launched from level ground at $20$ m s$^{-1}$ at an angle of $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. Taking $g=10$ m s$^{-2}$, what is its horizontal range?

verdicts.working: Use R = u² sin(2θ)/g = 400 sin 60°/10 = 20√3 m.

working:
$u_x=20\cos30^\circ=10\sqrt{3}$ m s$^{-1}$; $u_y=20\sin30^\circ=10$ m s$^{-1}$. $0=u_y t-\dfrac{1}{2}gt^2\Rightarrow t=2$ s. $R=u_xt=20\sqrt{3}$ m.

Independent check: Use R = u² sin(2θ)/g = 400 sin 60°/10 = 20√3 m.
solution:
For a projectile returning to the same level, $R=\dfrac{u^2\sin 2\theta}{g}$.
$$R=\dfrac{20^2\sin 60^\circ}{10}=20\sqrt{3}\text{ m}$$
